item.title: US, Canada survive overtime scares in men’s hockey quarterfinals
item.description: MILAN — When the U.S. gave up a tying goal to Sweden with 91 seconds left in the quarterfinals at the Olympics, even the most seasoned players were on edge.

item.title: US star Shiffrin become 3-time Olympic champion with slalom win
item.description: CORTINA D’AMPEZZO, Italy — Mikaela Shiffrin stood atop the Olympic podium, looking almost in disbelief at the gold medal around her neck.

item.title: Luzerne County’s employee pension fund ends 2025 with 12.2% investment return
item.description: Luzerne County’s employee pension fund grew to nearly $350 million at the end of 2025 — a new record high, fund advisor Richard Hazzouri, of Morgan Stanley, said during Wednesday’s county Retirement Board meeting.

item.title: Meat distributor, apartment building get Wilkes-Barre zoning nod; Vape/smoke shop denied
item.description: WILKES-BARRE — Del Caribe Meat Company received zoning approval to transform the former Nardone Brothers bakery at 123 Hazle St. into a family-owned meat distributor specializing in Dominican-style sausage, salami, hams, smoked meats, and ribs.

item.title: Grandson of the inventor of Reese’s Peanut Butter Cups accuses Hershey of cutting corners
item.description: The grandson of the inventor of Reese’s Peanut Butter Cups has lashed out at The Hershey Co., accusing the candy company of hurting the Reese’s brand by shifting to cheaper ingredients in many products.

item.title: District 2 roundup: Hazleton Area boys power past Scranton in 6A quarters
item.description: Hazleton Area broke open a tied game at the half with a 22-5 edge in the third quarter to defeat Scranton 58-40 in the District 2/4 Class 6A subregional quarterfinals on Wednesday night.

item.title: D2 Girls Basketball: Abington Heights rides early lead, beats Pittston Area
item.description: CLARKS SUMMIT — Emma Coleman led Abington Heights in scoring, as expected, but it was a first-quarter boost from others that got the Comets started.

item.title: D2 Girls Basketball: Dallas uses defense to advance to 5A semis
item.description: DALLAS TWP. — A two-week layoff before a playoff game certainly isn’t ideal. And while second-seeded Dallas showed some effects on one end of the court Wednesday night, they showed little on the other.
